{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''No one'', not even a ''Jedi'', can escape my crystal prison!|[[Sülphurr Cyander]]|<ref name="Spices & Spies" />}}
A '''crystal prison''' was a type of portable [[Prison/Legends|prison]] that could be activated from a [[crystal round]] by a [[harmonic inducer]]. During a [[Skirmish in Mos Espa|skirmish]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Sülphurr Cyander]] used a crystal prison in an attempt to restrain [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and [[Ttekket]].
